capture_source: live capture 2026-08-26 at the transport seam; SAP A4H kernel 793 release 758, sysnr 00, unicode, codepage 4103. RFC_GET_FUNCTION_INTERFACE for BAPI_USER_GET_DETAIL. Sanitised preserving byte length: GW conversation handle at [40:48] and the 16-byte 0x0514 session token. No NI length prefix.
evidence: return code 0x0420 == 0; the PARAMS table decompresses to exactly row_size x row_count and every row parses into a FieldDesc
notes: The PARAMS table is COMPRESSED. The server switches to SAPCOMPRESS once a table passes roughly 8 KB (RfcTable::rfcSerialize compresses when row_size * row_count >= 0x2001 = 8193); here 404 x 44 = 17776.
The eight 0x0305 records are FRAGMENTS OF ONE STREAM, not independently compressed blocks. They must be concatenated (8 x 250 = 2000 bytes) before anything can be decompressed.

The joined payload begins with an 8-byte wrapper - [4B unidentified][4B BE compressed length = 1921] - and the SAPCOMPRESS stream starts at offset 8: [4B LE uncompressed length = 17776][algo byte 0x12 = LZH][2B magic 1f 9d][config]. The trailing bytes after the compressed stream are padding to the 250-byte record size.

0x0302 declares row_size 404 while the documented 12-column layout occupies 402; the extra 2 bytes are alignment padding. Tag 0x0310 carries the used width (402) separately. Slice the decompressed blob by the 0x0302 stride, not by a constant.

Contrast with the per-row form: when rows arrive as individual 0x0303/0x0304 records, each record is one row at its USED width and the 0x0302 stride may be larger (a structure-definition response in the same session declared 140 while every record was 138 bytes). Concatenating those and re-slicing by the stride would misalign every row, so the two shapes need different handling.
Before this was handled, any function module large enough to be compressed - which is most BAPIs - produced an empty FunctionDesc with no diagnostic.
